title: Health Screening Turnaround Coach
oneLiner: A post-checkup reset planner that turns scary health-screening flags into a calm 8-week routine for food, movement, sleep, and retest readiness.
targetUser: Adults who just received concerning annual health screening results and want a structured lifestyle turnaround plan before medication or worse numbers become unavoidable.
keyUX: Translate red-flag lab numbers into a simple weekly recovery plan with clear behavior targets, emotional reassurance, and visible progress toward the next test date.
stitchPrompt: Design a desktop wellness guidance product called Health Screening Turnaround Coach for adults who just received concerning annual health screening results. It should help users understand what changed, lower panic, and follow a realistic 8-week plan for food, movement, sleep, stress control, and retest preparation before the next appointment. Include a risk and retest summary, an 8-week habit runway, meal and movement plan cards, a sleep and stress tracker, a lab marker trend panel, and a doctor question prep drawer. Design direction: use a calm-consumer aesthetic with soft neutral surfaces, reassuring blue-green accents, gentle progress framing, and clear guided cards so the product feels steady, humane, and health-serious without becoming clinical or scary.
